subject: Fraud & Scams
title: The Math Behind the Collapse
description: A short lesson to help you apply The Math Behind the Collapse.

hook.text: Every Ponzi scheme is a ticking clock. The math guarantees it will collapse.

buildup.text: If each investor is promised 50% returns, the fund must double its participants constantly.

discovery.text: After just 10 rounds of doubling, you need over a thousand new investors for every original one.

twist.text: Eventually you run out of people. Earth has a finite population — Ponzi math doesn't care.

climax.text: Most Ponzi schemes collapse within a few years. The rare ones that last are just slower burns.

punchline.text: Exponential growth has an enemy: reality.

quiz.question: Why does every Ponzi scheme eventually collapse?
options: It runs out of new investors
